document:
version: 4
relay_servers:
  - relay-asia-1.example.com:21117
  - relay-asia-2.example.com:21117
websocket_signal:
  relay_health:
    endpoints:
      - {relay: relay-asia-1.example.com:21117, url: wss://relay-asia-1.example.com/ws/telemetry, telemetry_secret_file: /run/secrets/starry-relay-telemetry}
      - {relay: relay-asia-2.example.com:21117, url: wss://relay-asia-2.example.com/ws/telemetry, telemetry_secret_file: /run/secrets/starry-relay-telemetry}
relay_quality:
  enabled: true
  probe_timeout_ms: 1000
  report_timeout_ms: 15000
  max_telemetry_age_seconds: 180
